brief: 5 red flags in your first 10 hires that will haunt you for 3 years.

slots.body: The wrong first-10 hire costs more than their salary. It costs your culture.

slots.title: Hiring Mistakes Compound Fast
slots.body: Your first ten hires set the DNA of your company. Bad fits don't quit quietly.
slots.calloutBody: One toxic early hire can repel the next fifty candidates.

slots.title: They Blame Everyone Else
slots.body: Candidates who play the victim in interview stories become toxic teammates overnight.
slots.calloutBody: Listen for 'I' versus 'they' when they describe past failures.

slots.title: They Talk More Than Listen
slots.body: Dominating the interview is a preview of dominating every meeting. Ego scales poorly.
slots.calloutBody: Great hires ask questions. Bad ones only perform monologues.

slots.title: They Need Perfect Conditions
slots.body: If they require luxury tools to start, they won't survive startup chaos.
slots.calloutBody: Scrappiness is a skill. Look for resourceful problem solvers.

slots.title: They Dismiss the Mission
slots.body: Indifference to your 'why' becomes indifference to customers and teammates.
slots.calloutBody: Hire believers. Skills transfer; passion rarely does.

slots.title: They Gossip to Impress
slots.body: Trash-talking former employers in interviews becomes office politics later.
slots.calloutBody: Professional discretion is a minimum, not a nice-to-have.

slots.body: Save this list. Check it before every offer letter. Your future self will thank you.
